o: dp[i] = max operations to delete suffix s[i:]. From position i we may delete a prefix of length j (1 ≤ j ≤ (n−i)/2) only if s[i..i+j) equals s[i+j..i+2j), gaining 1 + dp[i+j]. Checking equality naively is O(n) per pair → O(n³) overall; with n = 4000 we instead precompute lcp[i][j] = length of the longest common prefix of s[i:] and s[j:] via the classic DP lcp[i][j] = (s[i]==s[j]) ? lcp[i+1][j+1]+1 : 0, making each comparison O(1). Example "aaabaab": dp yields 4 as shown by deleting "a","aab","a",rest.
k: lcp[i][j] computed bottom-up turns every substring-equality test into O(1).
dp[i] depends only on dp[i+j] for larger i, so fill right to left.
